h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hajipur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hajipur

items.pText: Hajipur faces Patna across the Ganga, near the point where the Gandak joins it, and the town is known for its bananas and its industrial area. Schools, colonies and residential projects on this side of the river ask us for playground equipment. FunPlay Systems makes every piece at our factory in Vasai, about 1,440 km away, and sends it to Bihar by road.

A useful way to plan a play area is to sort the equipment by how much looking after it needs. Fixed pieces such as slides, climbers and play stations have no bearings or springs to wear out. Moving pieces such as swings, see-saws, spring riders and merry-go-rounds give children plenty of fun but need regular checks. If nobody on site can do those checks, we suggest a play area built mostly from fixed equipment.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Fixed and moving equipment: what each needs

c: Fixed equipment needs a wash, a look at the bolts and a check of the flooring every few months. Moving equipment needs more attention. Swing hangers, springs and merry-go-round bearings wear with use. That is why our warranty on springs, bearings and spare parts is 1 year, against 3 years on pipes and moulded parts. Ask one staff member to inspect these parts every month and report anything loose or noisy. Hajipur's humid monsoon makes this routine more important.

items.q: Which playground equipment needs the least maintenance?
items.a: Fixed pieces such as slides, climbers and multi play stations, since they have no springs or bearings. A regular wash and a check of the bolts and flooring is usually enough.

items.q: How often should swings and spring riders be checked?
items.a: We suggest a quick monthly check of hangers, springs and bearings, and an immediate one if a part squeaks, wobbles or looks worn. Our after-sales team can advise on replacement parts.

items.q: Do you deliver to Hajipur and the Patna area?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Hajipur, Patna and nearby towns by road, and install it through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
